drugs.mechanism: Reduces production of vitamin K-dependent clotting factors.
indications: Prevention and treatment of venous thromboembolism
interactions: Herbal products such as St John's wort
food: Keep vitamin K intake (leafy greens) consistent day to day; do not suddenly change it
Alcohol and cranberry in large amounts can affect INR
supplements: Vitamin K, multivitamins containing vitamin K, fish oil and vitamin E: discuss before starting or stopping
monitoring: INR at intervals set by the clinic
